name: Universal Autofoundry Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2009, Universal Autofoundry 
 Ltd does manufacturing and sales of C.I. 
 Castings[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
UAL is a global manufacturer and exporter specializing in the production of Grey Iron, Ductile Iron, and SG Iron Casting. The company manufactures Cast Iron and SG Iron components ranging from 5 kg to 150 kg, including intricate, cored, and fully machined parts. It produces around 100,000 units per month, catering to OEMs, MNCs, and export markets.
